USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Latasha Burke
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0132 | latasha.burke@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Assistant store manager at a consumer electronics retailer with ten years on the sales floor, now running daily operations for a store with $11 million in annual sales. Over the past two years has become the district's go-to person for store reporting: a Tableau workbook used by nine stores, Excel analysis of a district bundle pilot and automated daily sales tracking. Since early 2026 also writes basic SQL against the district sales reporting database. Seeking a move into a retail reporting or analyst role.

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Store Manager | Voltline Electronics, Columbus, OH | Apr 2020 to Present
• Oversee daily operations and a team of 28 sales, service and stock employees.
• Automated the daily sales to goal workbook with Power Query, pulling the company's daily sales extract by department and employee instead of retyping it; department supervisors get it before the store opens.
• Built a Tableau workbook in 2025 showing sales, attachment rate and labor hours per store against plan, first from a weekly extract and since 2026 from a saved SQL query; the district manager opens it on the Tuesday call with all nine store managers.
• Measured a district pilot that bundled TV wall mounts with mid-size TVs at three stores against three similar comparison stores over eight weeks in Excel. Mount attachment rose from 18% to 27% with no drop in TV margin, and the district extended the bundle to all nine stores.
• Pulled a year of hourly door counter traffic and sales into Excel and showed that weekday evenings were understaffed relative to conversion; moving four shifts raised evening close rates and kept labor within 0.5% of budget for most of 2025.
• Compiled a monthly shrink analysis by category and SKU from inventory adjustment data, which helped the district loss prevention lead put the 15 most stolen items in locked display.
• Monitor protection plan and accessory attachment by employee and coach staff below target; store attachment rose from 22% to 29% over two years.
• Lead quarterly physical inventory preparation and daily cycle counts on high value items.
• Covered as acting store manager for three months in 2024, keeping the store at 101% of its sales plan for the quarter.
• Given read access to the district reporting database in February 2026; writes SQL with joins across sales, item and store tables to answer district manager questions, such as which open box SKUs sat unsold longest by store.
• Coordinate holiday hiring and onboarding of 10 to 12 seasonal employees each year.

Sales Consultant | Voltline Electronics, Columbus, OH | Jul 2016 to Mar 2020
• Sold computers, tablets and home theater systems, averaging 112% of personal sales goal over three years.
• Kept a personal Excel log of sales and customer follow ups that later became a template for the department.
• Trained new hires on the point of sale system and product knowledge.
• Named the store's top seller of protection plans in 2018 and 2019.
• Set up weekly merchandising resets from corporate planograms.
• Helped the department supervisor count open box and display inventory each month.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2016

SKILLS
BI and spreadsheets: Tableau (one workbook used across a district), Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, SUMIFS, charts), Google Sheets
SQL: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and joins against a SQL Server reporting database (used at work since 2026)
Retail systems: point of sale, inventory lookup, Kronos scheduling
Retail operations: labor planning, sales coaching, shrink control, inventory counts, merchandising resets

ADDITIONAL
• Excel Skills for Business specialization (Coursera), 2023
• Completed an introductory SQL course online with practice on a sample retail sales database, 2025
• Completed the company's assistant manager development program, including store P&L and inventory control modules, 2020
